sourceEvidence.title: Quality Assurance Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
**Education & Experience**
* Bachelor of Science degree required with five to seven years related experience and/or training.
**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**
* Should have knowledge of Accounting software; Database software; Human Resource systems; Internet software; Inventory software; Manufacturing software; Order processing systems; Project Management software; Spreadsheet software and Word Processing software.
* HACCP Certification
* SQF Practitioner Certification
